senses.en_definition: To take someone else's property without permission; to steal.
To do something secretly or without being noticed.

messages.en: Hey, my phone's not on the table anymore. Did someone steal it, or did I put it somewhere else?
Check your bag first. You put it away when the food arrived, remember?
Ah, there it is! Tucked under my wallet. I forgot I'd put it there.

senses.en_definition: To get, obtain, or receive something.
To experience or encounter a situation, especially something unpleasant.

messages.en: I've got a new job! I start this Monday.
Wow, congrats! Where will you be working?
At a company near my place. No more long commutes!
I've noticed two identical names on this list. Shall I check them first?
Yes, please check. They might be two different people with the same name.

senses.en_definition: To obtain or secure something through effort.
To go or come to someone; to approach or meet someone.
To visit or pay one's respects at a place, especially a grave (classical usage).

collocations.en: pay one's respects at a grave (classical usage)
stop along the way to pay one's respects at a grave (classical usage)

senses.en_definition: To address a letter to someone (in traditional letter openings).

collocations.en: to my dear elder brother or sister, or my beloved (traditional letter opening)
to my fondly remembered elder brother or sister, or my beloved (traditional letter opening)

messages.en: Do I need to go to the office first to get that assistance?
No need to go there first. Just fill in the form online, and someone from the office will get in touch with you.
